messages:
incident-bot: [PAGER] High: ILB route propagation errors detected affecting Private VPC cross-region traffic (eu-west -> us-west). Multiple customers reporting control-plane connection failures. Paging: @oncall-networking :rotating_light:

oncall-networking: on call here, seeing alerts. tagging net-team. pulling up healthchecks and route advertisements.

jamal: I’m on it. first step: confirm whether routes are being withdrawn or not propagating. running `gcloud compute forwarding-rules list` across regions.

leo: got customer slack saying their private endpoints to us-west APIS are timing out. fluss shows backend health toggling between UNHEALTHY/UNKNOWN.

sarah: I can repro with a test Private deployment in eu-west -> it fails to reach control-plane in us-west intermittently. traceroute shows ILB IP reachable but connection resets mid-flow.

maria: adding GCP status: gcp-status-bot, any visible network control-plane incidents?

gcp-status-bot: GCP: We are investigating increased control-plane latencies for Internal LB route updates in multiple regions. Impact: route propagation delays and ILB health check misses. Status page: https://status.cloud.google.com/incidents/ilb-routing (ticket 2026-3421).

jamal: ok that's consistent. looks like a GCP-side route propagation/regional controller flapping. mitigation options: 1) failover customer traffic to same-region endpoints (if available) 2) create temporary proxy in eu-west to front us-west control-plane (adds latency) 3) request GCP to roll affected routing controllers (support).

beth: CS: we have three customers currently affected (cust-a, cust-b, cust-c). cust-b is on a private VPC with strict egress — they see failed model inference and API timeouts. they want ETA.

jamal: messaging for customers: "We're seeing GCP Internal Load Balancer route propagation issues impacting cross-region connectivity for Private VPCs. Our engineers are coordinating with GCP. Mitigation steps underway: temporary regional proxy and, where possible, local fallback. We'll update every 30m."

leo: taking ownership of temporary proxy deploy. spinning up a small proxy fleet in eu-west to forward control-plane calls to us-west via a pinned egress path. sketching terraform snippet:```hcl
resource "google_compute_instance" "proxy" {
  # small nginx+tcp-proxy
}
```

jamal: also opening support case with GCP: case 1234567890, escalated to networking engops. sharing debug logs: traceroutes, ILB healthcheck traces, BGP/route table snapshots.

infra-bot: deploy bot: CI pipeline queued for `infra/proxies/eu-west` with image `proxy:v2`. Runbook flag: `ilb-crossregion-fallback`.

sarah: deployed a 2-instance proxy canary. I see some requests succeed vs fail ratio improved from 30% to 85% for the test tenant. leaving canary running and scaling to 4.

jamal: good. applying emergency routing rule to pin egress to a specific NAT path to avoid transient controller decisions (temp ACL work). Noting: this is a local workaround, does not fix GCP controller issue.

beth: CS updated: customers notified with mitigation plan and asked to route their non-critical traffic through proxy. Cust-b accepted temporary proxy.

leo: handoff note for night shift — @leo -> @jamal at 22:00UTC. jamal will monitor proxy, coordinate with GCP support for controller restart/update, and update customers every 30m.

jamal: handoff ack. I’ll create a follow-up thread with ticket numbers and escalation contacts. current status: partial mitigation in place (proxy up, routing pinning applied), GCP investigating. impact: degraded cross-region Private VPC control-plane traffic for 5% of user requests; full outages for some tenants with strict egress/NAT rules.

gcp-status-bot: Update: GCP networking has applied a partial fix to ILB controller in region us-west. Route propagation success rate improving. Monitoring for recurrence.

maria: will we need a postmortem? recommend yes since cross-region ILB propagation is high severity for Private deployments. tagging postmortems channel.

jamal: agreed. capture timeline, customer impact, support case IDs, and our mitigation (proxy template + routing pin). Will schedule incident review tomorrow 1400 UTC.

beth: CS: customers request ETA for full remediation. Recommended statement: "GCP has applied a partial fix. We're monitoring and expect stabilization in the next 1-2 hours; we'll confirm when fully resolved."

leo: monitoring graphs look stable for the last 6 minutes; success rate ~95% for proxied traffic. removing canary tag and scaling to 6.

incident-bot: Incident status changed -> WATCHED (mitigated). responders: @jamal @leo @sarah. Next update window in 30m.

jamal: final note before handing off to oncall: keep support case open until GCP declares full resolution and we see stable routing for 2 hours. add link to debug bucket: gs://redwood-debug/ilb/1802501234/

oncall-networking: handoff complete to night shift. thanks team.
